plugins.name: Cursor
plugins.description: Use your own Cursor subscription as an OpenAI-compatible provider in CLIProxyAPI, with a management page to import Cursor IDE / token.json credentials.
plugins.author: rh01

plugins.name: Factory (Droid)
plugins.description: Use your own Factory Droid subscription as an upstream provider in CLIProxyAPI for OpenAI chat/responses and Anthropic messages, with streaming, tool calls and a management page for account import and device login.
plugins.author: rh01

plugins.name: CPA Prometheus
plugins.description: Prometheus metrics for CLIProxyAPI usage, Management Center dashboard counts, and provider quota windows. Served only on the management-authenticated route GET /v0/management/plugins/cpa-prometheus/metrics.
plugins.author: giovannirco, rh01
